Markets.title: Bitcoin leads crypto market rebound above $85K as short liquidations accelerate

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk: Rupee under pressure, inflation sticky: Will RBI be forced to rethink rates? Ankita Pathak, Ionic Asset
Markets.summary: India faces a tighter monetary policy trade-off as the rupee remains under pressure and inflation broadens while the US Federal Reserve enters a tightening cycle. According to Ankita Pathak of Ionic Asset, these factors may narrow the RBI's policy flexibility while elevated US yields and a stronger dollar weigh on Indian equities and capital flows.

Markets.title: Danish brewing giant Carlsberg’s India arm, 3 others get Sebi nod to float IPOs
Markets.summary: India's market regulator has approved initial public offerings for Carlsberg's local entity, TMC Transformers, Ujin Pharma, and Matangi Rubber. TMC Transformers plans to raise Rs 550 crores through new equity to fund a manufacturing plant.

Markets.title: Global Markets | Japan's Nikkei retreats from 6-week high as investors lock in gains
Markets.summary: Japanese rubber futures declined slightly alongside Tokyo equities as investors locked in gains amid interest rate and geopolitical concerns. Despite this pullback, the market continues to face supply challenges due to declining natural rubber production and consumption.
